description_en: An arched-top woven backpack with textile zipper, padded shoulder straps, leather bottom and front woven pocket. Canonical front: a raised woven front pocket and arched zipper. Side view: the deep curved gusset and side strap anchor. Rear view: two padded straps, top loop and plain breathable back panel. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: An arched-top woven backpack with textile zipper, padded shoulder straps, leather bottom and front woven pocket. Canonical front: a raised woven front pocket and arched zipper. Side view: the deep curved gusset and side strap anchor. Rear view: two padded straps, top loop and plain breathable back panel. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Modern: clean contemporary geometry. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings and continuous strips; solid wood/bamboo supports and secondary materials only where specified. Keep natural product resting/display orientation. Flexible mats/runners remain thin and flat, without unrequested feet, stands or rigid frames. All interiors empty. CAMERA: straight-on FRONT at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature. Upright products use center-height camera; thin horizontal products rest flat and use a modest downward camera to reveal the woven surface, not an overhead view. No three-quarter azimuth. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
